user.description: Connect to your AlphaESS inverter/battery on the local network.

init.description: Select the section you want to configure. Each section is saved on its own.

installation.title: Installation
installation.description: Physical specs of the roof PV, battery and inverter.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Supplier and network costs, VAT and the price sources. Pick an entity with day-ahead prices (e.g. from ENTSO-E, Frank Energie or Nord Pool) and add more as backups with 'Add entity': the first one that has prices is used.{missing_source_note}

data.price_entities: Price sources (in order; drag to change)

solar_forecast.title: Solar forecast
solar_forecast.description: The solar forecast locations (e.g. Forecast.Solar or Solcast): pick one of each location's sensors and add more with 'Add entity'. Locations of the same service are summed (e.g. the front and back of the roof); the service on top is used, another service only as a backup. Locations of the same service stay together, wherever they are in the list.{sources_note}{missing_source_note}

ev_charger.title: Consumption sources
ev_charger.description: Consumers kept out of the learned house load because they're big and irregular. Their power is taken off the measured house load before the load per hour is learned. Not used for control. Add as many as you have with 'Add entity'.

data_description.ev_charger_power_entities: Each EV charger's charging power. Shown together in the panel's energy flow.
data_description.ev_charger_energy_entities: Each EV charger's total charged energy (an increasing kWh counter). Shown per charger in the panel's daily totals. Optional.
data_description.ev_charger_phase_entities: Each EV charger's power per phase (L1, L2, L3), for its card on the Installations tab. Optional.
data_description.excluded_load_entities: The power of other big consumers, such as a heat pump. For the learning only, not in the panel.

meter.title: P1 meter
meter.description: Pick your smart (P1) meter's sensors here. They give the house load and the grid import the grid charge is regulated on. Without a meter the inverter's own grid reading is used.

data_description.grid_import_power_entity: The power drawn from the grid right now, e.g. DSMR's 'Power consumption'. If your meter has one sensor that is positive when importing and negative when exporting (like HomeWizard's 'Power'), pick it here and leave export empty.
data_description.grid_export_power_entity: The power fed into the grid right now, e.g. DSMR's 'Power production'. Leave empty when the sensor above is already positive and negative.
data_description.grid_tariff_entity: The current tariff, e.g. 'Active tariff', for the day or night network fee. Optional.
data_description.peak_load_this_month_entity: This month's highest 15-minute peak, e.g. 'Maximum demand current month' (Belgian meters only). The grid charge may go up to this peak. Optional.

control.title: Control
control.description: Scheduler behaviour and the master switch for battery control.

data.allow_provider_control_hours: Hours where the provider may override the schedule
data.persist_daily_charge_limit: At most one full battery a day, solar and grid together (off: no daily limit; discharge for own use only)
data.control_enabled: Enable battery control (writes real commands to the inverter)

user.title: Add PV installation
user.description: A solar installation next to the AlphaESS, with its own inverter. Its power counts in the energy flow, the house load and the learning of the solar forecast. Several installations are added up.

data_description.name: What the installation is called, in the panel and in the list of installations.

data_description.extra_pv_power_entities: The power the source delivers right now, e.g. the inverter's 'AC power'. Several sensors are summed (a second inverter, micro inverters, or the power per string).
data_description.extra_pv_string_entities: Panel display only: the power per MPPT input of the inverter, i.e. per line of panels (string), e.g. 'DC power string 1' and 'string 2'. Empty with the SMA integration: its own strings.

data_description.extra_pv_panel_count: With Wp per panel the source's peak power: for the bar in the panel, and to estimate its power when the reading is gone.

data_description.extra_pv_switch_entity: A switch that turns the source on (producing) and off, e.g. a Modbus switch on the inverter's power register. The control itself is turned on and off in the panel, under Controls.

reconfigure.title: Change PV installation
reconfigure.description: A solar installation next to the AlphaESS, with its own inverter. Its power counts in the energy flow, the house load and the learning of the solar forecast. Several installations are added up.

data_description.name: What the installation is called, in the panel and in the list of installations.

data_description.extra_pv_power_entities: The power the source delivers right now, e.g. the inverter's 'AC power'. Several sensors are summed (a second inverter, micro inverters, or the power per string).
data_description.extra_pv_string_entities: Panel display only: the power per MPPT input of the inverter, i.e. per line of panels (string), e.g. 'DC power string 1' and 'string 2'. Empty with the SMA integration: its own strings.

data_description.extra_pv_panel_count: With Wp per panel the source's peak power: for the bar in the panel, and to estimate its power when the reading is gone.

data_description.extra_pv_switch_entity: A switch that turns the source on (producing) and off, e.g. a Modbus switch on the inverter's power register. The control itself is turned on and off in the panel, under Controls.

pv_total_energy_feed_to_grid.name: PV total energy fed to grid

pv_total_energy_consume_from_grid.name: PV total energy consumed from grid

daily_min_profit.name: Minimum daily profit for optimized schedule

force_charge_grid.name: Force charge from grid
force_charge_grid.description: Override the current hour's schedule to force charging from the grid, until cleared.

force_discharge.name: Force discharge
force_discharge.description: Override the current hour's schedule to force discharging the battery, until cleared.

force_charge_pv.name: Force charge from PV
force_charge_pv.description: Override the current hour's schedule to force charging from solar production only, until cleared.

force_no_charging.name: Force no charging
force_no_charging.description: Override the current hour's schedule to force no battery charging, until cleared.

clear_manual_override.name: Clear manual override
clear_manual_override.description: Remove any active manual dispatch override, reverting to the scheduler's own decision.
